record.reason: StreamOPD post-trains streaming video models with OPD and cue gating; reported benchmark gains use an unchanged, memory-free recent-window inference protocol. It suggests quality can improve without runtime modules, but does not measure reduced inference cost relative to the same protocol.
record.title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
